description: Search-zone ranking dataset: one row per zone per 30 s snapshot of a replayed mission, with features, a synthetic priority target and a rule-based baseline score
records: 72576 rows (216 episodes x 21 snapshots x 16 zones)
generation_method: Seeded mission replay: 6 drones from drone_config.json, 4-neighbour moves on the 20x20 grid, 2 s ticks, 600 s, 3x3 sensor footprint, battery drain per drone_config.json, return-to-base rule, failure events from failure_scenarios.json (controller outage, partition, drone_unresponsive, packet loss, delay, battery override, no-fly activation); centralized = controller assigns zones, drones without a controller link finish their last assignment then idle; decentralized = local claims shared only inside the peer component; hybrid = centralized when the controller is reachable else decentralized fallback; a task completes when required_drones distinct drones observe its cell (est_duration_s ignored)
provenance: Fully derived from DS-01, DS-02, DS-03 plus fixed seeds; re-run the script to reproduce byte-identical output
labels_target: priority_target = clip(1.6 * content_value * accessibility + N(0,0.025), 0, 1); content_value = 0.34*L*u + 0.22*U*(0.4+0.6*P) + 0.14*P*u + 0.10*E + 0.08*S*u + 0.06*S*c*L; accessibility = sqrt(1/(1+dist/12)) * (1-0.45*hazard_fraction) * comm_penalty * (0.6+0.4*min(1,battery/60)) (x0.3 if no drone available); L=hidden latent survivor density per zone (0.50*risk+0.22*(priority-1)/4+0.18*person_present_in_zone+N(0,0.10), fixed per map, not exported); u=1-coverage; c=coverage; P=priority_level/5; U=sigmoid((120-min_deadline_slack)/50) if pending task else 0; E=min(1,0.5*detections)*max_confidence; S=staleness (1 if never observed else 1-exp(-since_last_obs/240)); comm_penalty=1-dead_zone_overlap*(0.15+0.25*[controller down or partition])
split_scheme: split column: seed_index 0=train, 1=validation, 2=test (same maps in every split); use GroupKFold on episode_id; for out-of-map generalisation hold out a whole scenario_id; do not use zone_id/scenario_id/row_id/seed as features
intended_use: Compare a fixed rule-based zone priority score with a simple ML ranker (Random Forest / Gradient Boosting); evaluate ranking quality and effect on task order
limitations: Labels come from documented synthetic rules plus a hidden latent, NOT real survivor probabilities; an ML model learns the generator, so describe results as a simulation experiment; only 3 maps with 16 zones each, so zone-level memorisation is possible if IDs are used as features; snapshots within an episode are autocorrelated; no detection is ever verified in the replay, so detection_count means unverified candidates
quality_checks: no missing values; exactly 16 zones per snapshot; coverage in [0,1] and non-decreasing except when no-fly cells shrink the denominator; last_observed_time <= snapshot time; no duplicate (episode, time, zone); one split per episode; ranks are 1-16 with no ties
seed_policy: seeds from failure_scenarios.json test_matrix; label noise seed 20260921
